༄༅/ /chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis kyi mngon rtogs bskang gso bcas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis kyi mngon rtogs bskang gso bcas bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi/ /bka' sdod bstan srung kun gyi gtso/ /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum la/ /'dud do brtse bas dgongs te skyongs/ /'dir chos rgyal gyi mngon rtogs phyogs 'di'i 'don tshul dang mthun par bsdus nas brjod par bya ste/ chos rgyal gyi bris sku dang chos gtor sogs sta gon byas nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang ste mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed ni/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥbasangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying ga nas brjis pa'i ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus dbyug to la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he rab tu khraus pa'i gdong pa can/ rwa rnon po gnyis dang ldan pa/ bskal 'jig pa'i dus kyi me'i phung po dang mtshungs pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu blta ba/ /zhal rab tu gdangs shing 'bar ba'i mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas ljags rnam par bskyod pa/ smin ma dang sma ra rab tu 'bar zhing*/ skra kham pa gyen du 'dzings la 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yas thod dbyung 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub rab tu bsgreng bas dus kyi zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas ma he rab tu khros pa'i rwa phrag nas brdzis shing*/ g.yon brkyangs pas ma he rab tu khros pa'i tshang steng nas brdzis pa/ mi rus kyi rgyan gyis spras pa/ spom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du tsi dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral ba nag po g.yengs shing*/

nu ma 'phyang ba shin tu 'jigs shing mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ dud 'gro'i pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis kyi 'khor du gshin rje ya ba ti be con 'dzin pa/ phywa bsang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rmig pa gsal shing 'dzin pa/ ral pa tshar dgu can mdung 'dzin pa rnams rgyal po'i tshul dang*/ blon po'i tshul dang*/ sde dpon gyi tshul dang*/ pho nya'i tshul du gnas pa/ gzhan yang gshin rje mig dmar dang*/ til ba dang*/ glang mgo can la sogs pa lag na gsal shing dang*/ 'khor lo dang mdung la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa/ re re'ang dgra bo'i srog len cing*/ gshin rje pho rgyud kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gshin rje pho nya mo nag mo lcags kyu thogs pa/ dus kyi zhags pa mo nag mo zhags pa thogs pa/ gshin rje dam sri ma nag mo be con thogs pa/ gshin rje sreg ma nag mo mche ba 'bar ba thogs pa/ gzhan yang dus mtshan ma dang*/ gsod ma dang*/ nag mo dang*/ nam gru dang*/ sha ka li dang*/ gshin rje 'bebs ma dang*/ gshin rje mtshan mo nag mo la sogs pa la la lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum la zhon pa/ la la bong bu ga pa la zhon pa/ la la rlung nag tshub ma zhon pa/ la la chu bya nag po la zhon pa/ la la las kyi me long dang*/ la la nad kyi rgyal ba dang*/ la la mtshon gyi gru gu dang*/ la la bdud kyi khram shing dang*/ la la sho rde'u dkar nag thogs pa/ re re'ang nad bdag ma mo gshin rje mo rgyud kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ be con gyi phyag rgya rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas ste/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ nag po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis/ lho phyogs rim pa bdud kyi sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug gi nang nas chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥ'ajam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum la ba ti/ pho nya mo la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam gling lho yi phyogs/ /mthar byed lcags ky-i thod mkhar 'bar ba nas/ /lho sprin nag po rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ākar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjaud pas chos rgyal 'khor bcas thogs pa med pas bdun du byon par bsams la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros gshin rje gshed rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bha ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las/ srin lag gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pas dam tshig gi phyag rgya snying gar bzhag ste bstan la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ya ma ra dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod de de'i 'khor gdug pa can rnams kyis rang la glags blta mi nus par bsam zhing*/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs/ mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang*/ /'phrin las mdzad phyir ji srid du/ las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas 'dir mchod pa 'bul tshul tshigs lhugs su 'byung ba de'am de'i don bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i thod pa'i nang*/

khrag gi rgya mtsho zhag gi rba klong 'khrug /dmar ser lbu ba'i phreng ldan mchod yon 'di/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ dgra bgegs dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*/ lha dang mi yi me tog sna tshogs pa/ lhun stug gzhal med rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= puṣ+pe= rab 'bar ro sol phung bo'i me nang du/ bam chen gsar snying bsregs pa'i du ba'i spṛn/ baiḍūr+ya yi lhun po brtsegs 'dra ba/ /gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= dhū pe= tshil chen zhun mar zhing gi khyon gang bar/ ro skra'i sdong bu ri ltar btsugs pa la/ /rab 'bar mar me'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= ā lo ke= /ga bur ngad ldan khrag zhag rgya mtsho yi/ /lus kun phyags pas gdung ba kun sel zhing*/ zag med bde ba'i dpal ster dri chab 'di/ /gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= gan+dhe= 'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /sha dang khrag gi phung po ri ltar spungs/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i lha yi zhal zas tshogs/ gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= nai wi d+ya= rdza rnga zom rnga rnga zlum rnga bo che/ zangs dung rkang gling cang te'u la sogs pa/ snyan cing brjid pa'i sgra ldan rol mo'i tshogs/ gshin rje'i= oṃ kā la= shap+ta'i bar dang*/ rū pa nas spar sha'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ oṃ mchod do sku bzhi'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal du= rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi= slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje'i= chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal= mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i= gzhan yang gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du= kā la rū pa oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ tsa muṇ+ḍi ya ba ti la sogs pa'i gshin rje dreg pa pho brgyad mo brgyad dang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bka' sdod bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/

bstod pa ni/ 'jam dpal bka' nyan bstan bsrung ni/ dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po ste/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs gzugs can/ mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bsdu na de tsam mam/ srid gsum ma mo kun gyi bdag /yum mchog nag mo tsa muṇ+ḍi/ /ya ba ti dang phywa bsang sogs/ /gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs la bstod/ /de nas yig brgya brjod de/ bshags pa dang bskang gso bsdus pa rje dge bdun rgya mtsho dang rgyal ba paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa gnyis snang ba las snga ma'i de 'don pa dang 'dug pas/ de ltar na bshags pa ni/ hūṃ/ bla ma mchog dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*/ bka' sdod bsrung mar bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma chos skur ma rtogs par/ /nyon mongs dbang gis log lta bgyis pa dang*/ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig ma bsrungs dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /dam tshig las 'das bsnyen bsgrub g.yel ba dang*/ /mchod gtor sman dang dam rdzas sbags pa sogs/ /mdor na sgo gsum sgo nas nyes pa'i tshogs/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur ba ci mchis pa/ /bla ma yi dam bsrung mar bcas pa la/ /spros bral chos dbyings ngang du bshags par bgyi/ /de nas bskang rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las bskang rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba la byung ba'i/ /bla ma yi dam chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma yi dam chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba 'di pū ra/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ sbar sha āḥhūṃ/ bskang gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

bskang gso ni/ hūṃ bde chen lhun grub gdod ma'i rang bzhin las/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum spyan lam du/ /legs par 'byung bas dgyes pa bskyaid gyur cig /dmar chen khrag gi mchod yon dgra bgegs kyi/ /dbang po'i me tog sha sna'i dud sprin dang*/ tshil chen mar me zhag chen dri chab dang*/ sha rus zhal zas sna tshogs rol mo 'dis/ /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum thugs dam bskang*/ /dregs pa pho brgyad mo brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /bka' sdod las byed thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ / rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /rlung ltar myur mgyogs rta nag tshogs rnams dang*/ /mig sman mdangs chags stobs ldan ra dang lug /rngams brjid g.yag rgod dgra 'joms gcan gzan dang*/ 'phur lding rol pa'i bya nag tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos kyi rgyal po= char sprin ltar nag drag po'i nga ro can/ /rngams pa'i kha rlangs dus kyi sprin ltar g.yo/ /rdo rje'i rwa ldan dgra bgegs srog la rol/ /rab brjid mdzes pa'i ma he'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos kyi rgyal po= dam nyams klad la rngams pa'i thod dbyug dang*/ /dgra bgegs 'ching byed dus kyi zhags pa dang*/ /srog 'phrog mtshon cha khram bam thod khrag sogs/ /bstan dgra 'joms pa'i cha rkyen dam pa 'dis/ /chos kyi= zhing chen g.yang gzhi mgo phreng do shal dang*/ rdo rje'i go mtshon dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs/ /'dod yon sna lnga lhun po gling bzhir bcas/ /phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /chos kyi= rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /'dir 'dod na paṇa chen gyi gsung ltar/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rung 'dul phyir gshin rje'i skur bstan pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid du/ /yid ched gsol 'debs bla med rten mchog 'dis/ /chos kyi rgyal = /sgrub par mdzod/

/ces brjod na'ang legs ste chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum thams cad ni 'jam dpal gyi 'phrin las rnam 'phrul du bshad pas so/ /stobs chen gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ /a ti sha dang blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad la/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /de nas bzlog pa ni/ chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /zhes nas/ thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ zhes dang*/ mthun pa'i dngos grub nas srung ma'i tshogs/ /zhes spyi ltar bya'o/ /de nas sngags gnyis ci 'grub bzlas nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi spu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drang te gsol bar gyur bar bsams la/ hūṃ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi sa pa ri= khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun dang*/ ya ba ti la sogs pa'i gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bsdu na/ kā la rū pa i daṃ nas khā hi khā ti/ tsa mu ḍi ya ba ti la sogs pa'i zhes byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas oṃ kā la ru pa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ nas shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod pa'i rjes/ chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas la/ /zhes sogs brjod dam min yang rung ngo*/ /de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma yang bsngos la/ hūṃ kā la rū pa rab brjid drag po'i sku/ kha nas khrag 'dzag mi mgo'i phreng ba yi/ /ga shal rab 'phyang mi bzang bdud dpung gi/ nga rgyal dregs pa 'joms pa khyod la bstod/ /ca co che ldan rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang*/ /cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtor ma ni/

/ja chang phud dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha /nya sha khrag zhags rgya mtshos brgyan pa 'bul/ /ta tha ga ta'i bstan la gnod byed pa'i/ /tha chad dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa dang*/ /da nas bzung ste rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms la bstod/ /pa ba sangs ltar rab dkar mche ba gtsigs/ /pha rol 'joms pa'i spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyug /ba spu dus mtha'i me chen 'bar ba yis/ /ma lus bgegs dpung bsreg pa khyod la bstod/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi sogs ma mo kun gyi bdag /tsha zer rab tu rgyas pa'i gzi brjid can/ /dza zhes 'phrin las bsgrub la bos pa'i tshe/ /wa skyes lta bu'i bgegs 'joms khyod la bstod/ /zha ltar 'byung po kun gyis spyi bos bsten/ /za byed ma he khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing*/ /'a 'ur dar dir sgrog pas sa chen g.yo/ /ya las skyes pa'i thod dbyug 'dzin la bstod/ /rwa dang rmig pa rno ba'i ma he dang*/ la la rlung nag tshub ma zhon pa'i 'khor/ sha ka li dang gshin rje 'bebs ma sogs/ /sa gsum 'byung bo'i 'khor gyis bskor la bstod/ /ha ha drag tu bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /ar+ghaṃ la sogs mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*/ /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed kyi spyan snga ru/ /zhal bzhes dam bca' g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ ma skyes ma 'gag chos dbyings klong yangs nas/ /ma ha kā li srin mo khros pa'i sku/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir rtse gsum thod khrag 'dzin/ ma mo chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi la bstod/ /ma he'i gdong can gshin rje'i dga' ma khyod/ ma rungs dgra la kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /ma lus bdud kyi srog gcod bshan pa mo/ /ma yengs bstan pa'i bsrung ma khyod la bstod/ /ma gcig 'dod pa'i khams la dbangabasgyur ma/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /ma mo'i dal yams la sogs cho 'phrul gyis/ /ma dul gdul dka' 'joms pa khyaud la bstod/ /ma bcos rang bzhin dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings/

/ma gtogs bdud kyi cho 'phrul ci byung yang*/ ma chen khyod kyi ming nas bos pa'i tshe/ /ma g.yel myur du byon la mthu rtsal skyed/ /ma rungs rnams la rab tu khros gyur kyang*/ /ma ltar brtse bas bstan 'dzin skyong ba khyod/ /ma sring chung ma bran mo'i tshul bzung nas/ /ma bskul bar yang mthun pa'i las kun sgrubs/ /ma nor lam mchog ston pa'i bla ma dang*/ / ma rig mun sel rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /ma dad log par bsgrub pa'i gdon dang bgegs/ /ma bsgral ba rnams chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don du rnal 'byor ngas/ /mañju gho ṣa'i go 'phangs dam pa de/ /ma thob de srid nag mo chen mo khyod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs/ /ma mo chen mo bstod cingabaskul bas bdag /ma rig 'khrul pas bskyed pa'i 'khor ba 'di/ /ma stongs bar du bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ ma hā kā lis rtag tu grogs byed shog /hūṃ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /srog la rngams pa'i gshin rje ni/ /nag po ma he'i gdan steng du/ /ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni/ /thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba/ /gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong*/ /za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsegs/ khros pa'i spyan rtsa dmar po 'khrug /skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes/ /lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching*/ /g.yas pa dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /ma mchen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi/ /rtse gsum thod khrag 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bran dang bcas pa'i dus la bab/ /sa chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod pa bzhes/ /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*/ /snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus/ /sod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis/

/phyai zhig gnon cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul zhig choms shig rnam par shig /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ bsdu na de yan gyi chog la/ rgyas par na/ hūṃ 'jam dpal bka' nyan sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi phror dmar la brjid pa'i zhes sogs kyi bstod pa'am/ yang na /ma lus rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung*/ /gtum drag gshin rje khros pa'i skur bstan nas/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dge sdig shan 'byid dam nyams srog gi bdud/ /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum las mdzod cig /dam can bka' nyan ya ba ti la sogs/ /srog gcod gshin rje'i tshogs kyis= /dam can bka' nyan pho nya mo la sogs/ /nad bdag ma mo'i tshogs kyis= dmacan bka' nyan rngams shing brjid pa'i sku/ /phyogs skyong 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos las mdzod cig /ces byas na'ang legs so/ /chos rgyal nang sgrub ni/ hrīḥṣ+tīṃs bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma gnod byed kyi gdan la g.yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro bo'i zhal can srin po khros pa lta bu bskal ba 'jig pa'i zhes pa nas skra kham ser gyen du 'dzings la 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ /g.yon pa khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi rus kyi rgyan gyi spras shing*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba'o/ /de'i phyogs bzhir shar du gshin rje dkar po g.yas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon mda' dar me long gis brgyan pa 'dzin pa/ lho gshin rje ser po g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ nub tu gshin rje dmar po g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang du gshin rje sngon po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/

bzhi ka'ang ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brjes shing*/ mi mgo bskam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdan la bzhugs shing*/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa'o/ /de dag gi 'khor du gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyo bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ g.yas be con gyi phyag rgya dang*/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ nag po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i zhes sogs sngar ltar te khyad par ni/ dzaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje nag po che/ /bka' sdod las bzhi'i gshin rje 'khor dang bcas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /zhes pa nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ mchod pa sngar bzhin nam tshigs lhugs kyis 'bul na/ g.yon pas khrag chang gi mchod yon gzung la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ ar+ghaṃ gsol bas dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ/ zhag gi me tog rgya mtsho ltar mi zad pa 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥnas ar+ghaṃ pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ g.yon pas me tog bzung ste/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ me tog phul bas me tog gi khang ba brtsegs pa tog ba bad dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad zug pa/ bla re dang*/ gdug dang*/ phreng bas brgyad pa/ rin po che'i rang bzhin can 'byung bar gyur cig= /puṣ+pe pū dzaḥ= hūṃ/ sha chen gyi spos bzung ste/ gshin rje'i= sha chen gyi bdug pa phul bas/ gzhal yas khang gi mgul du 'dug pa'i sprin baiḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu rin po che brtsegs pa 'dra ba 'byung bar gyur cig/oṃ=

sa pa ri wā ra dhū baṃ pū dza= hūṃ/ zhun chen gyi mar me bzung ste/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la zhun chen gyi mar me phul bas gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su mun pa 'joms pa lta bu'i 'od gsal ba 'byung bar gyur cig /oṃ= dī paṃ pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ dri bzung ste/ gshin rje'i= bcas pa la khrag zhag gi byug pa phul bas/ lus dang gnas ky-i dri ma dag ste/ reg na bde ba'i reg bya dang dri snam bzod pa dang ldan pas tshim par gyur cig /oṃ= gan+dhe pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ lha bshos bzung ste/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bshos phul bas kha zas dri dang ro dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po dang bcas pa kham gyi zas la gnas pa rnams tshim par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan par 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ hrīḥ= badz+ra nai wit+ya pu dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ rol mo bzung ste/ gshin rje'i= sil snyan phul bas shes rab kyi sgra phun sum tshogs pa rna ba'i bcud len rgyas par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig /shap+ta pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ ces brjod/ de nas oṃ sarba bid spu ra pū ra sū ra sū ra ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya ho badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod ky-i sngags brjod de mchod/ de nas nang mchod lta bu la cung zad ma gtogs sngar ltar la/ bskang gso'i skabs su/ chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ zhes dang*/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /las kyi gshin rje bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ /bka' sdod can zhes bsgyur dgos so/ /gshags pa dang bskang gso rgyas par 'dod na paṇa chen gyi gsungs ltar byas na legs so/ /bsnyen pa ni gtso bo'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ gtor ma ni/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hī khā hī/

lan bdun gyis phul nas/ oṃ gā la rū pa sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshe/ oṃ kā la rū pa oṃ āḥhūṃ/ las bzhi'i gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ de nas bstod pa ni/ namaḥshri badz+ra bhai ra wa ya/ brkyangs bskums zhabs ni cung zad brdabs pa tsam gyis dkyil 'khor bzhir bcas ri dbang shig shig bor 'gyur zhing*/ gtum drag ma he'i zhal ni rab tu gdangs bas bsgrags pa'i gad rgyangs chen pos sa gsum kun 'gengs pa/ rgyal pa'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs gang ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /gang der gus pas btud nas gshin rje'i rgyal po bstod kyis da ni bgegs rnams bag yod dus la bab/ /ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrugs pa lta bur 'ur 'ur zhes pa'i sgra chen rgyud mar rab sgrog pa/ drag po'i me lce gnag pa'i du bas 'khyud pa'i tshogs rnams 'bum phrag klog phreng char sprin nang 'khyug bzhin/ /shin tu bzod dka'i reg bya tsha ba'i ngad ldan kha dog lnga yi phreng bas zlum por bskod pa'i dbus/ /mun pa bye bas byugs ltar gnag pa'i chos 'byung chal chil g.yo ba'i khrag zhag rgya mtshos gang ba'i steng*/ rta bdun bdag po'i gdan la gnod byed nag po gan rkyal bsgyed pa'i steng na gshin rje'i rgyal po ni/ mig sman ltar gnag thung la sbom pa'i lus can g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums sa chen g.yo ba'i gom stabs can/ ser skya'i ral pa gyen du 'dzings pa'i dbu la thod bskam lngas brgyan drag po'i rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ khrag gis spags pa'i mgo rlon phreng ba mgrin par 'phyang zhing spyan gsum bgrad pa'i sdang mig g.yo ba can/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i bgrad pa'i zhal nas dbugs phreng g.yo ba gdug pa'i sprul gyi kha rlangs bzhin/ g.yas pas 'bar pa'i gri gug bdud dpung klad la 'phyar zhing khrag ldan thod pa g.yon gyis bzung la rol/

/stag pags smad g.yogs bgos pa'i gtum chen khyod kyis gshin rje'i gshed la ji ltar zhal bzhes de bzhin du/ ma g.yel ma g.yel myur du dran par mdzod la rnal 'byor bdag gis gang zhig bsgo ba thams cad sgrubs/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi phyogs bzhir rwa dang rmig pa rab tu rno ba'i ma he drag po'i gdan steng na/ dkar dang ser dang dmar dang gnag pa'i gshin rje chen po drag tu khros pa'i ma he'i gdong ba can/ /brkyangs bskums stabs kyis rab tu 'gying zhing dur khrod chas kyis legs brgyan zhal gdangs mig rtsa kun tu dmar/ /bgegs dpung 'joms la rdo rje'i thogs ltar bsngags pa de dag gis kyang zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrubs/ /mdor na rgyal ba kun kyis yang dang yang bsngags 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes sa steng kun tu grags pa de'i/ /phun tshogs go 'phang mchog de mkha' mnyam lus can kun gyi don du ji srid bdag gis ma mnan pa/ /de srid gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' ni gus pas lhur len chos rgyal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /yang dag lam gyi nor mchog 'phrog la brtson pa'i nag po'i rtsa lag sdai dang bcas pa gzhom par mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ spro na/ 'jam dpal bka' nyan ma'i mjug tu/ dmar la brjid pa'i spyan gsum gyis zhes pa nas 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod cing 'phrin las bcol bar bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la phan snyam ste co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'o/ //maṅgalaṃ/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis kyi mngon rtogs bskang gso bcas bzhugs/ - PAGE 200-- PAGE 201-- PAGE 186-
